description: Tier-1 self-authored Figma fixtures for the dashscene importer (see docs/decisions/figma-corpus-self-authored-only.md). Each entry maps a fixture name to the Figma file key of a file authored in the project's own account. The capture tooling fetches GET /files/:fileKey?plugin_data=shared (docs/decisions/figma-access-plan-and-pat-policy.md, docs/decisions/annotator-plugin-contract-frozen.md) and commits the returned JSON into corpus/figma-fixtures/<name>.json for offline record-and-replay (docs/design/dashc.md).
provenance: self-authored via the fixture-author dev plugin (importers/figma/plugin/fixture-author); Community-license-safe because nothing captured here is a third-party file (docs/decisions/figma-corpus-self-authored-only.md).

captureParams.note: ?plugin_data=shared is always passed so sharedPluginData roles (docs/decisions/annotator-plugin-contract-frozen.md) round-trip even though no fixture carries them yet.

fixtures.name: v03-paint
fixtures.covers: v0.3 paint vocabulary under fixed layout (layoutMode NONE): solid fill, all four gradient kinds (linear/radial/angular/diamond), an image fill with a scale mode, the three stroke aligns (inside/center/outside), uniform and per-corner corner radii, and a clipsContent frame with an overflowing child
fixtures.note: Authored with the fixture-author plugin's v03-paint command (importers/figma/plugin/fixture-author/README.md). Designated input for the Figma REST lowering (#139) and the Deno importer (#17).

fixtures.name: grid-basic
fixtures.covers: GRID mode: row/column spans, fixed+flex tracks, hug/fill/fixed children, min/max constraints
fixtures.note: Lowers since #264 (the v0.8 grid un-pin): GRID -> LayoutMode::Grid with gridColumnGap/gridRowGap as the main/cross gaps, the gridColumnsSizing/gridRowsSizing strings as Fixed/Fraction track lists, and per-child anchors/spans as placement (docs/decisions/figma-flex-lowering.md D5, docs/decisions/v08-layout-vocabulary-shape.md). The raw capture emits (its one TEXT leaf lowers since #160); crates/dashc/tests/flex_lowering.rs solves it font-free (the TEXT leaf swapped for a FRAME fixed at its captured box) to the captured rects. #272 (a Fixed child larger than its Fraction cell) is not exercised: the one fixed child (140x60) is smaller than its 252x164 cell.

fixtures.name: variables-bound
fixtures.covers: boundVariables on color + number props across light/dark modes; one subtree pinned to dark
fixtures.note: token phase 1 is implemented (#159): the boundVariables IDs are preserved in the <out>.vars.json sidecar (importers/figma/src/tokens.ts, docs/decisions/token-resolution-phase-split.md) while the resolved literals emit as ordinary properties, so tokens no longer gate this fixture. Phase 2 (id->name/collection/mode join) join table is committed as variables-bound.vartable.json — the annotator plugin's token-export output (#39), which #167 joins the sidecar against. The TEXT children lower since #160; emits stays false on the one remaining layout blocker: the Fill cards sit on the hug root's axis (a Figma-vs-CSS sizing divergence, docs/decisions/figma-flex-lowering.md D5).

fixtures.name: effects-2025
fixtures.covers: REJECT-list constructs: noise, texture, progressive blur
fixtures.note: DIAGNOSTIC fixture (corpus/figma-fixtures/README.md): under R6 emits no .dsb; the test asserts the diagnostic report names each construct as an error. Variable-width stroke (4th REJECT construct) pending manual application — no plugin API.

fixtures.name: lowering-wrap
fixtures.covers: WRAP auto-layout: fixed-width children wrapping at a fixed container width
fixtures.note: Lowers since #264 (the v0.8 wrap un-pin): layoutWrap: WRAP -> LayoutMode::Wrap with itemSpacing as the main gap and counterAxisSpacing as the cross gap (docs/decisions/figma-flex-lowering.md D5, docs/decisions/v08-layout-vocabulary-shape.md). Fixed-size chips, no text, so the raw capture solves font-free to the captured rects (crates/dashc/tests/flex_lowering.rs).

fixtures.name: lowering-hug-in-fill
fixtures.covers: HUG child inside a FILL container (Figma->CSS sizing lowering) with a HUG TEXT leaf
fixtures.derivedEmits: the TEXT leaf swapped for a FRAME fixed at its captured box (crates/dashc/tests/flex_lowering.rs) emits goldens/dsb/v07-hug-in-fill-derived.dsb and solves to the captured rects font-free
fixtures.note: Raw compile emits since #160 (text lowering): the HUG text leaf lowers with its characters and style (goldens/dsb/v07-text-hug-in-fill.dsb), and the scene solves through the measure callback and paints (goldens/images/v07-text-lowering.png). The auto-layout chain lowers since #140. The TEXT->FRAME derivation is kept as a font-free solve-fidelity check.

fixtures.name: lowering-negative-gap
fixtures.covers: negative itemSpacing (-16) overlap row of full ELLIPSE nodes: the gap lowers to margins (docs/design/dashbuf.md) and each ellipse lowers to a circle (docs/decisions/figma-ellipse-as-circle.md)
fixtures.derivedEmits: the ELLIPSE children retyped as FRAMEs (crates/dashc/tests/flex_lowering.rs) emit goldens/dsb/v07-negative-gap-derived.dsb and solve to the captured rects, kept for cross-language ABI parity with the Deno suite (a frame and a circle solve to one box); and, with the root's HUG width lifted to FIXED (goldens/tooling/tests/v07_ellipse.rs), the five circles solve and paint goldens/images/v07-ellipse.png
fixtures.note: Raw compile emits since #239: the five full ELLIPSE children lower to circles (a rounded rect with corner radius = half the 56px extent, goldens/dsb/v07-negative-gap.dsb), and the negative-gap lowering itself lands since #140. Root hug width solve is engine debt #236, so the render golden lifts it to FIXED to avoid clipping the circles.

fixtures.name: lowering-baseline
fixtures.covers: mixed-size BASELINE alignment row (docs/technotes/open-questions.md, Q-4) + Arabic RTL run with Arabic-Indic numerals (E2)
fixtures.derivedEmits: with the root's BASELINE cross-axis alignment lifted to MIN (crates/dashc/tests/text_lowering.rs), the mixed-size Latin rows and the Arabic RTL run lower and emit goldens/dsb/v07-text-baseline-derived.dsb
fixtures.note: Lowers since #264 (the v0.8 baseline un-pin): counterAxisAlignItems: BASELINE -> CrossAxisAlign::Baseline (Q-4), and the raw capture emits (its TEXT children lower since #160). Its solved rects diverge from the capture: the engine's leaf baseline is the box bottom, not the glyph baseline (debt #273), so crates/dashc/tests/flex_lowering.rs pins the lowered intent only, not a solve match. The BASELINE->MIN derivation is kept for the text-lowering golden. The Arabic run is basic Arabic (U+0621-U+064A), so #228 (extended-Arabic joining sweep) does not fire and re-defers.

fixtures.name: lowering-variant-topology
fixtures.covers: component set whose variants have different child counts (topology change) + one instance
fixtures.note: Raw compile emits since #242 (docs/decisions/figma-component-lowering.md): the COMPONENT_SET/COMPONENT definitions resolve but do not paint (this story lowers the authored state; the v0.4 variant table that would carry the alternative members is consumer-side and out of scope), so the set's dashed stroke (debt #145) never reaches the paint gate; only the instance's baked (collapsed) subtree lowers to the gray container, the dark 'state: collapsed' label, and the one blue row (goldens/dsb/v07-variant-topology.dsb, rendered goldens/images/v07-variant-topology.png). COMPONENT_SET/COMPONENT/INSTANCE lowering lands with this story.

fixtures.name: real-file
fixtures.covers: production-shaped file for the v0.7 real-file import spike (story #37): two pages, extra top-level frames beside the export root, a component set with an instance, a hidden layer, an image fill
fixtures.note: Awaiting manual authoring: run the fixture-author plugin's real-file command in a blank Figma file, paste the file key here, and run `just deno-capture` (importers/figma/plugin/fixture-author/README.md). Raw compile will be refused until INSTANCE lowers; the fixture exists so the export closure (declared roots, per-set variant closure, exclusion naming) replays against a real multi-page response.

fixtures.name: trim-demo
fixtures.covers: trim-path exercise (story #39): one declared root holding a placeholder slot (with sample children), a redline overlay, a spec note, a `_`-prefixed scratch layer, and a hidden layer (hidden != trimmed)
fixtures.note: Awaiting manual authoring: run the fixture-author plugin's trim-demo command, then write the roles with the SEPARATE dashscene annotator plugin (importers/figma/plugin/README.md — the fixture author never writes roles), paste the file key here, and run `just deno-capture`. The trim rules themselves are covered offline by importers/figma/src/trim_test.ts and the import-level test; this fixture replays annotate -> trim -> named record against a real ?plugin_data=shared response.

fixtures.name: xfile-library
fixtures.covers: cross-file library resolution (story #38), library half: a published component set (two variants) that xfile-consumer instances across files
fixtures.note: Awaiting manual authoring — this is a two-file pair and no plugin API publishes a library or instances a component across files, so both files are authored by hand (the real-file/trim-demo precedent). Step 1: in a blank file author a component set with two variants; PUBLISH it as a team library; paste its file key here. Step 2: author xfile-consumer (below) instancing this set. Then run `just deno-capture`. On its own this file carries only definitions (resolve-but-don't-paint); it exists so xfile-consumer's remote instance resolves against a real GET /file library response.

fixtures.name: xfile-consumer
fixtures.covers: cross-file library resolution (story #38), consumer half: one declared root holding an INSTANCE of a REMOTE component published by xfile-library (its components map carries remote:true plus the library key)
fixtures.note: Awaiting manual authoring (see xfile-library step 2): in a second file, instance a variant of xfile-library's published set inside a frame, paste this file's key here, and run `just deno-capture`. Import with a manifest that declares the root and `libraries: [<xfile-library file key>]`; resolution splices the library definition in and the pair compiles end-to-end (docs/decisions/figma-cross-file-library-resolution.md). The resolution MECHANISM is covered offline by importers/figma/src/closure_test.ts and import_test.ts against synthetic and fixture-derived pairs; this captured pair replays remote-instance resolution against real ?plugin_data=shared responses.

fixtures.name: text-latin
fixtures.covers: Latin text in Noto Sans Regular (the committed ascii atlas font) for the E7 render oracle (frame v05-text-latin, msdf-text band): 'Hello dashscene' (28) + '88 mph' (44) in a fixed 480x200 frame
fixtures.note: Awaiting authoring: run the fixture-author plugin's text-latin command in a blank Figma file named text-latin, paste the file key here, run `just deno-capture` (importers/figma/plugin/fixture-author/README.md). Authored in Noto Sans, not Inter, so the render oracle measures the reference painter's MSDF glyphs against Figma's render of the SAME font, not a substitution (goldens/oracle/README.md). Strings are printable ASCII, covered by corpus/atlas/ascii. The TEXT leaves lower since #160.

fixtures.name: text-arabic
fixtures.covers: Arabic RTL text in Noto Sans Arabic Regular (the committed arabic atlas font) for the E7 render oracle (frame v06-text-arabic, msdf-text band): a banner, a harakat word, and an Arabic-Indic numeral readout in a fixed 520x240 frame
fixtures.note: Awaiting authoring: run the fixture-author plugin's text-arabic command in a blank Figma file named text-arabic, paste the file key here, run `just deno-capture`. Numerals are authored as Arabic-Indic codepoints (not European), so both Figma and the reference render the same glyphs. Basic Arabic (U+0621-U+064A) plus harakat and Arabic-Indic digits, all covered by corpus/atlas/arabic. The TEXT leaves lower since #160.

fixtures.name: text-baseline
fixtures.covers: mixed-size Latin BASELINE-alignment row in Noto Sans Regular (the committed ascii atlas font) for the E7 render oracle (frame v08-baseline): 'small' (12), 'medium' (24), 'LARGE' (40) baseline-aligned in a fixed 380x120 frame
fixtures.note: Awaiting authoring: run the fixture-author plugin's text-baseline command in a blank Figma file named text-baseline, paste the file key here, run `just deno-capture` (importers/figma/plugin/fixture-author/README.md). Authored in Noto Sans, not Inter, so the render oracle measures the reference painter against Figma's render of the SAME font in a fixed box. Once captured and wired it replaces lowering-baseline as the v08-baseline oracle frame (goldens/oracle/manifest.json still maps v08-baseline to lowering-baseline until then), whose Inter leaves rendered in Noto Sans resized its HUG root and could not be diffed. counterAxisAlignItems BASELINE lowers to CrossAxisAlign::Baseline since #264; the TEXT leaves lower since #160. Unlike the stacked text-latin/text-arabic frames, this frame exercises baseline alignment of mixed-size runs: the engine's leaf baseline is the box bottom, not the glyph baseline (debt #272), so the oracle measures that alignment fidelity against Figma. Strings are printable ASCII, covered by corpus/atlas/ascii.

fixtures.name: drop-shadow
fixtures.covers: one DROP_SHADOW on a rounded card for the E7 render oracle (frame v08-drop-shadow, blur-falloff band): offset y=4, blur 6, spread 0, black alpha 0.55
fixtures.note: Awaiting authoring: run the fixture-author plugin's drop-shadow command in a blank Figma file named drop-shadow, paste the file key here, run `just deno-capture`. A DROP_SHADOW with a present color and NORMAL blend is on dashc's accept path under Profile::Core (crates/dashc/src/figma/{triage.rs,mod.rs}); the parameters are the v08_shadows golden's proven-rendered values. The oracle pins the sigma = blur/2 mapping (docs/decisions/effects-vocabulary-shadows.md, G-1) against Figma's own render (#304).

fixtures.name: inner-shadow
fixtures.covers: one INNER_SHADOW on a rounded card for the E7 render oracle (frame v08-inner-shadow, blur-falloff band): offset 0, blur 6, spread 0, black alpha 0.55
fixtures.note: Awaiting authoring: run the fixture-author plugin's inner-shadow command in a blank Figma file named inner-shadow, paste the file key here, run `just deno-capture`. Same clean-lowering path and sigma = blur/2 pinning as drop-shadow (#304).
